title: Version differences for string assertions in assert()
summary: PHP 7.2 deprecated string assertions. From PHP 8.0, assert() checks the string value for truthiness.
detail: When an assertion runs in PHP 7.x, assert() evaluates the contents of a string argument. PHP 7.2 deprecated that behavior and PHP 8.0 removed it.
boundary: PHP 7.2 retained the old behavior after deprecation. Configuration can disable or skip assertions, so the version alone does not show that a particular call evaluated the string.
relevance: When reading the PHP source code attached to the old question, the same string parameter may represent different judgments in different versions.
